_pilot: PILOT — ONE clip (walk) from the TEXTURED GLB, to prove PBR-through-EEVEE colour before wiring all 5. Reusable pipeline; this job just exercises it on walk. source=glb -> import_scene.gltf (keeps the PBR material the FBX lost). keepSourceMaterial=true -> NO flat-grey toon override (that override ghosted the FBX); Material_1's 4096² base-colour texture is the point, downscaled to maxTextureSize (1024) so EEVEE doesn't blow memory / over-sharpen. The Meshy GLB ships a stray un-skinned 'Icosphere' beside 'char1' — the importer keeps only the skinned body and DROPs the Icosphere (logged 'DROP non-character mesh'). Every clip TRAVELS (root motion baked); inPlace=true strips locomotion per-frame for ALL clips (Z bob kept), so the figure renders centred. Camera/framing/anchors/dirs are IDENTICAL to the grey render (thug_gangster.json) so #51's dirOffset still applies and it drops into the loader unchanged — orthoScale is AUTO-locked by the bbox pre-pass for THIS mesh (won't be exactly the placeholder's 2.0125; the loader normalises in-game size by manifest.figurePxH via spriteDisplayScale, so world-scale stays consistent). output.viewTransform=Standard renders true texture colour (EEVEE's default AgX would tone-map what K is judging).
_run: Windows PowerShell (SPLIT STREAMS so Meshy's heavy stderr edge-warning spam can't abort the gate; ErrorActionPreference Continue): $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; & $env:BLENDER_PATH -b -P tools\blender\render_iso_unit.py -- --job tools\blender\render_jobs\thug_walk.json --engine BLENDER_EEVEE 1> thug_walk.out 2> thug_walk.err ;  then paste thug_walk.out. DO NOT pngquant/squeeze the result — photoreal bands harder than flat grey; hold squeeze until colour is confirmed (may need >256 colours).
_output: Overwrites public/assets/sprites/units/thug_walk.png (intended — the colour version) and writes a WALK-ONLY thug_manifest.json (pilot; the full 5-clip render re-locks ONE shared scale across all clips + rewrites the full manifest). Raw GLBs stay in assets/raw/thug_glb/ (gitignored) and never go to public/.

camera._note: Identical lock to thug_gangster.json: 2:1 tiles -> dimetric2to1 (60deg from top-down). If the gangster faces wrong in-game, calibrate at runtime via unitSpriteView dirOffset (do NOT diverge the render from the grey one).
